text:
Alicia: heads-up: encountered an SDK vs REST parity bug during onboarding tests. python sdk's `routes.archive()` returns success for missing routes, but curl shows 404. sample-app's onboarding assumes archive fails and recreates; now onboarding leaves stale state.

Jamie: curious which sdk & python version? can you paste quick repro?

Alicia: repro (py3.10, redwood-sdk==1.12.0):
```py
# SDK call
client.routes.archive('stg-nonexistent')  # -> returns {'archived': True}
```
vs curl:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/stg-nonexistent/archive -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# -> HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```

Noor: hmm. server sometimes returns 204 for idempotent archive ops but should not lie and return 404 then client map to 200. is the sdk swallowing 404s?

Alicia: SDK debug shows: `200 GET /v1/routes/stg-nonexistent -> handled by client: idempotent success` (weird since this is POST archive).

Sam: that log indicates the client layer has a special idempotency normalization that maps not-found -> success for archive/delete endpoints. that's dangerous: callers may need to react to missing resources.

Noor: agreed. sample-app onboarding relies on error to decide "create" vs "reuse". silent success breaks idempotent create flow.

Jamie: I'll open a patch. Proposed behavior: default = surface raw server status and throw for non-2xx. Add an opt-in flag `idempotent_quiet=True` for callers who want the old mapping. Also add `raw_status` on responses for observability.

Alicia: sounds good. can we add an integration test simulating a 404 from server and asserting SDK raises? This should be added to the sdk CI and sample-app e2e.

Sam: also check JS SDK parity — they may have same compatibility layer. don't want language fragmentation.

Jamie: noted. creating RED-4820. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1104. Plan: change default in 1.12.1, include migration note in changelog, and update sample-app to not rely on silent success.

ci-bot: Created issue RED-4820 and linked to pipeline task (pipeline 7844).

Noor: for short-term mitigation, sample-app will do existence check after archive and recreate if missing. push incoming.

Alicia: thanks. also log showed stale retry middleware converting 404->200 after a retry backoff; we should audit retry layer to ensure it preserves original status when mapping. putting that in the ticket.

Sam: will add unit tests for retry middleware behavior.

Jamie: ETA for patch: tomorrow midday. will run canary and coordinate release notes. any objections?

Noor: none. prioritize tests.

Alicia: thanks team :rocket:
